info.desc: to hell with it is the debut mixtape by PinkPantheress, released on October 15, 2021, via Parlophone and Elektra Records. The project blends dance-pop, UK garage, and liquid drum and bass, with strong 2000s influences. It tackles themes like failed relationships, adolescence and longing, using samples and genres like bedroom pop, hyperpop and pop-punk. PinkPantheress gained attention by posting short song snippets on TikTok, which went viral and led to a record deal. Singles such as "Pain", "Just for me" and "I must apologise" became popular, especially on TikTok. The mixtape received widespread critical acclaim for its nostalgic samples, cohesive .
